actual_saved_runtime_update_facts.scope: Observed registered Parameter identities, requires_grad and version-counter update coverage; not numerical equivalence or proof against target tampering.

final_model_plan.title: Freeze backbone parameters to exclude them from optimizer state
final_model_plan.description: Set requires_grad=False on all backbone parameters before constructing the optimizer, so AdamW only tracks head parameters. This removes the persistent optimizer state (moments) for ~30B backbone parameters, eliminating the dominant optimizer_state peak. The forward pass still runs through the backbone in eval mode, preserving the frozen feature extraction. The loss, optimizer step, scheduler, and gradient reset cadence remain unchanged because only the head parameters are updated.
final_model_plan.risk: Backbone must not be needed for gradient-dependent operations (e.g., frozen batch-norm statistics). Source shows backbone.eval() but requires_grad was never disabled.

final_model_evidence_requests.detail: Observed tensor shapes, optimizer_input_name, and effective_batch_per_optimizer_update from the retained baseline run are needed to confirm the exact training-update contract and input path before patching.

conclusion: The final diagnosis follows the intended-head label rather than the executed full-parameter update set. Real positive update-set facts were already captured but not forwarded; the catalog was forwarded but not selected. Current static shape/count guards do not prevent changing the optimizer parameter set or disabling gradients without shrinking the model.
